feed.heading: Who he was
life: A native of Thessalonica, born of noble parents, Demetrius rose to command the Roman forces in Thessaly. Despite these honors he put his faith in Christ before all, and by word and example brought many pagans to the faith.

Denounced to the Emperor Maximian, he was imprisoned. He blessed the young Nestor, who defeated the champion Lyaios in the arena; then soldiers slew Demetrius with spears in his cell, in 306. Fragrant myrrh flowed from his body, healing many.
feed.intercession: Holy Great-martyr Demetrius, pray to God for us.
feed.caption:
Today (October 26, New Calendar) the Church keeps the feast of the Holy Greatmartyr Demetrius of Thessalonica.

Born of a noble family in Thessalonica, Demetrius commanded the Roman forces in Thessaly, yet put his faith in Christ before every worldly honor and brought many to the faith.

Under the Emperor Maximian he was imprisoned and killed with spears in his cell, in the year 306. Fragrant myrrh flowed from his body and healed many of the sick, and for centuries he has been the patron saint of Thessalonica.

Holy Great-martyr Demetrius, pray to God for us.
